site_name: Land West of Edmond Street and Newman Drive and Benson Close, Burnham-on-Crouch, Essex
evidence_slice: Maldon District Council's statutory weekly list for the week ending 20 February 2026 records major hybrid planning application 26/00018/FULM at Land West of Edmond Street and Newman Drive and Benson Close, Burnham-on-Crouch, Essex, UPRN 010094634635. The proposal comprises full planning permission for 170 dwellings and outline planning permission for up to 190 further dwellings, for a maximum residential quantum of 360 dwellings, with public open space, SuDS, associated infrastructure and retained employment land. At its 2 September 2026 District Planning Committee meeting, Maldon District Council resolved to approve the application in accordance with the addendum, with delegated grant subject to outstanding consultee matters and completion of a Section 106 agreement; this batch therefore records a committee resolution to approve subject to conditions and legal agreement, not a final grant notice.
